name: ping-emergence
arrow_rule: Draw every outgoing recurrent transmission initiated by a source spike in the current timestep.
event_arrows: Thin arrows mark spikes emitted in the current timestep.
conductance_style: Persistent connection width and opacity follow reconstructed per-synapse AMPA or GABA conductance after spike arrival and exponential decay.
conductance_display_limit: At most the 320 strongest active paths per recurrent projection are drawn in each frame; all current-timestep spike transmissions remain visible as arrows.
neuron_radius: Mapped from recorded membrane voltage between resting and threshold voltage; spike rings remain explicit after voltage reset.
input_visual: The exact seed-8 Poisson input raster is shown as 100 sources with private one-to-one spike arrows onto E; input units do not encode membrane voltage.
piston_panel: A compact vertical instrument bank at the top left shows mean excitatory conductance, inhibitory conductance, E voltage, and I voltage alongside the network row. Voltage shares one observed-range scale; conductance shares one zero-to-maximum scale.
phase_plane: A compact border-light phase portrait plots the same mean excitatory and inhibitory conductance signals used by the pistons, with a fading 20 ms trail.
rolling_raster: A rolling 20 ms raster shows every spike from all 100 input sources, 100 E neurons, and 25 I neurons in separate row bands.
visual_style: Conference-figure warm off-white; restrained typography; excitatory structure black; inhibitory structure red; separate event, conductance, and voltage keys.
layout: Borderless two-row grid: vertical mean instruments plus Input, E, and I across the top; conductance cycle and rolling spike raster split the bottom row equally.
layer_order: population panels, neurons, conductance, current-spike arrows, active-source rings, labels
comparison: Matched baseline and W_EI=0 simulations share all parameters, seed, input spike train, scales, and rendering rules.
input_ramp: A third condition linearly increases input rate from 20 to 160 Hz over 100 ms with recurrent E-I connectivity intact, to visualize recruitment of PING activity.
input_rate_plot: A compact plot above the Input population shows the full input-rate program, elapsed segment, and current-frame marker.
raster: A wide static raster keeps every Input, E, and I spike visible across the full 100 ms simulation while a current-time cursor moves over it.
